captions.detailed: A matte-black cinema prime lens featuring a large-diameter front barrel that flares out to a wide hood. A knurled, rubber-textured focus ring sits around the midsection of the barrel, followed by a narrower smooth iris ring band. At the rear of the lens is a metallic mount ring complete with a small locking lever. The glass elements at the front and rear have a reflective, semi-transparent bluish-grey optical appearance.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a cinema prime lens with a matte-black housing. It should include a flared front barrel, a knurled focus ring around the midsection, a narrower iris ring, and a rear mount ring with a small locking lever.
captions.factory: The lens is constructed by defining a series of coaxial cylindrical and conical segments using Cylinder primitives and loft/revolve operations to form the main barrel and front flare. The knurled focus ring is created by placing a series of small rectangular ribs radially around a central cylinder. A small box primitive is appended to the rear mount to represent the locking lever. Materials are assigned to differentiate the matte-black body, the metallic rear mount, and the glass elements.
